content: शीलः [शील्-अच्] A large serpent (the boa). .{@-लम्@} .²1 Disposition, nature, character, tendency, inclination, habit, custom; सा तस्य शीलमाज्ञाय तस्माच्छापाच्च बिभ्यती <ls>Mb. 3. 136. 4</ls>; समानशीलव्यसनेषु सख्यम् <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls>; frequently at the end of <ab>comp.</ab> in the sense of ‘disposed or habituated to’, ‘indulging in’, ‘prone to’, ‘addicted to’, ‘attached to’ <ab>&c.</ab>; as कलहशील ‘disposed to quarrel, quarrelsome’; भावनशील ‘disposed or apt to think’; so दान˚, मृगया˚, दया˚, पुण्य˚, आश्वासन˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Conduct, behaviour in general. .²3 Good disposition or character, good nature; शीलं परं भूषणम् <ls>Bh. 2. 82</ls>; <ls>Pt. 5. 2</ls>. .²4 Virtue, morality, good conduct, virtuous life, chastity, uprightness; दौर्मन्त्र्यान्नृपतिर्विनश्यति … शीलं खलोपासनात् <ls>Bh. 2. 42</ls>, <ls n="Bh. 2.">39</ls>; तथा हि ते शीलमुदारदर्शने तपस्विनामप्युपदेशतां गतम् <ls>Ku. 5. 36</ls>; <ls>Ki. 11. 25</ls>; <ls>Pt. 1. 169</ls>; <ls>R. 10. 70</ls>. .²5 Beauty, good form.
